summary.intent: Run the GSD manager dashboard to track milestone progress and discuss Phase 38 (retire deprecated web services) to capture implementation decisions in CONTEXT.md.
summary.outcome: Phase 38 context was captured with locked decisions on caller migration pattern, utility function placement, and circular devDependency fix. CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md were committed to the feature branch.

repo: Milestone v1.1 is 91% complete (22/24 phases done); only phases 38 and 39 remain.
folder.service.ts (1,059 LOC) and bin.service.ts (971 LOC) are the two deprecated web services targeted for removal in Phase 38.
SDK equivalents already exist: packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts and packages/sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts.
7 files import from folder.service.ts, 2 from bin.service.ts.
The established migration pattern (from prior phases) is: hooks import SDK methods directly and pass store-extracted state as explicit params — no adapter layer.
Pure utility functions getDepth, isDescendantOf (used by MoveDialog.tsx) and fetchAndDecryptMetadata (used by useFileBrowserActions.ts) are not yet in the SDK and need a home.
@cipherbox/crypto has a circular devDependency on @cipherbox/core solely for vault-ipns.test.ts.

code.finding: Canonical example of the SDK migration pattern: imports SDK functions directly, extracts store state, passes as explicit params.
Another reference for how SDK is consumed in the web app.
Imports deriveRegistryIpnsKeypair and initializeVault from @cipherbox/core, creating the circular devDependency that Phase 38 must resolve.

workflow: Discuss mode was 'discuss' (not 'assumptions'), so the full interactive discuss-phase.md workflow was used rather than the automated assumptions path.
Todo cross-referencing (todo match-phase) found matches but all were low-relevance false positives on generic keywords — silently skipped.
GSD manager re-reads state from disk on every dashboard refresh to pick up background agent changes.

friction: discuss-phase.md was read in 5 separate Read tool calls, suggesting the file is large enough to require paginated reads.
No USER-PROFILE.md exists, so advisor mode and calibration tiers are unavailable.
open_items: Phase 39 (user-configurable vault settings) is blocked on Phase 38 completing.
Decision on where to place utility functions (getDepth, isDescendantOf, fetchAndDecryptMetadata) was deferred to the planner — not locked in CONTEXT.md.
Exact approach for resolving the @cipherbox/crypto circular devDependency (inline test helpers vs. extract to test-utils package) was discussed but the final decision may need planner input.
Phase 38 planning (plan-phase 38) has not yet been run — CONTEXT.md is written but no PLAN.md files exist yet.
